name: reel-generator
description: Drop in whole phone videos and a song, get a reel cut to the beat. Python + FFmpeg + librosa, no AI. Live at makemyreel.in
readme_summary: Reel Maker is a Python-based tool that automatically creates Instagram Reels by analyzing video clips and music to sync cuts to the beat. It processes raw phone media, identifies key moments, and applies different editing styles without manual trimming or AI.
key_features: Automatic beat-synced reel generation
Intelligent moment selection from long videos
Handles various phone media formats (HEIC, HDR)
Multiple editing styles (Hype, Smooth, Cinematic)
Audio sourcing from YouTube links or uploads
Generates both a music and a silent version for Instagram
Privacy-focused with temporary uploads and deletions
primary_use_case: To automatically generate beat-synced video reels from raw video clips and a song, simplifying the video editing process for social media.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled conductor standing in front of a large orchestra, but instead of musical instruments, the orchestra members are holding video clips and photos. The conductor's baton is a glowing timeline, and with each precise movement, a video clip or photo is seamlessly cut and synchronized to an unseen beat. In the background, a large screen displays a vibrant, finished Instagram Reel. Subtle digital particles representing audio waveforms flow from the conductor's baton towards the screen. The scene is set in a modern, minimalist concert hall with dramatic lighting. The repository name 'Reel Maker' is subtly integrated into the conductor's podium. Style: 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic and vibrant colors.

name: seeker
description: Accurately Locate Smartphones using Social Engineering
readme_summary: Seeker is a tool that leverages social engineering by hosting a fake website to trick users into granting location permissions. Upon granting permission, it collects precise location data (longitude, latitude, accuracy, altitude) and various device information (unique ID, model, OS, hardware specs, IP addresses) without requiring explicit device permissions.
key_features: Hosts a fake website to request location permission
Collects longitude, latitude, accuracy, and altitude
Gathers device information via Canvas Fingerprinting and other methods
Obtains unique ID, device model, OS, hardware specs, browser details, and IP addresses
Performs automatic IP address reconnaissance
Offers various pre-made phishing page templates and allows custom template creation
Provides higher accuracy than traditional IP geolocation by using device GPS
primary_use_case: To demonstrate and educate users about the potential data a malicious website can gather by tricking them into granting location and other permissions, serving as a proof-of-concept for social engineering tactics.
cover_image_prompt: A digital illustration of a smartphone screen displaying a convincing-looking website that mimics a popular service asking for location access. As the user taps 'Allow', a subtle, almost invisible thread extends from the phone to a stylized, glowing orb representing collected data. This orb contains miniature icons of a map pin, a compass, and various device components. In the background, a shadowy figure representing 'social engineering' is subtly visible, pulling the thread. The overall mood is slightly mysterious, with a clean, modern aesthetic, emphasizing the deceptive nature of the interaction. The 'Seeker' logo is subtly integrated into the phone's UI.

name: roxum-ide
description: A minimal and powerful IDE/Code editor for Android
readme_summary: Roxum IDE is a Flutter-based mobile IDE for Android, offering a comprehensive suite of tools for code editing, terminal workflows, and AI assistance. It aims to provide a powerful and customizable development environment directly on mobile devices.
key_features: Flutter-based mobile IDE for Android
Built-in Termux support
Offline GGUF LLM model support for chat and code completion
Offline compilers and extensions for popular languages
245 built-in themes and custom theme creation
Built-in terminal
Rust-based editor backend
AI Code Completion
LSP support
Git and GitHub integration
SSH support
Integration with external AI providers
primary_use_case: To provide a fully-featured Integrated Development Environment (IDE) on Android devices, enabling mobile coding, debugging, and development workflows.
cover_image_prompt: A miniature, highly detailed workshop on a stylized Android device. Inside, a skilled artisan is meticulously crafting intricate code structures using glowing tools. One hand holds a tablet displaying a complex blueprint (representing code), while the other manipulates a small, glowing terminal. Around the artisan, various language symbols and AI-like energy particles float, signifying the integrated features. The overall scene is clean and focused, with subtle UI elements of Roxum IDE visible on the device screen. The art style should be a vibrant 3D isometric illustration, emphasizing the power and portability of a full IDE in your pocket.

name: note-gen
description: Capture first. Organize later. A local-first Markdown app that turns scattered records into clear notes with AI.
readme_summary: NoteGen is a local-first Markdown application designed to streamline the process of capturing and organizing information. It allows users to quickly save various types of content, such as text, voice recordings, screenshots, and links, without immediate organization. Later, users can select related captured items and use AI to organize them into structured Markdown notes, facilitating efficient knowledge management.
key_features: Local-first Markdown application
Capture diverse information types (text, voice, screenshots, links, files, todos)
Separate capturing from organizing
AI-powered organization of captured records into structured Markdown notes
Support for templates or descriptive organization prompts
Review and edit AI-generated drafts
Notes stored as standard Markdown files, compatible with other editors and Git
WebDAV synchronization
primary_use_case: To provide a seamless workflow for capturing fleeting ideas and scattered information, and then intelligently organizing them into coherent Markdown notes using AI, thereby enhancing personal knowledge management.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian standing in a vast, slightly chaotic library filled with scattered scrolls, voice recorders, and digital snippets. The librarian is using a magical quill that glows with AI energy, transforming these disparate items into neatly organized, illuminated books on a central shelf. The background subtly shows shelves of organized Markdown files. Small, ethereal data streams connect the scattered items to the quill. The scene is bathed in warm, inviting light, emphasizing clarity and order emerging from initial disarray. The style is a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on magical realism and clear visual storytelling, with the NoteGen logo subtly integrated into the library's signage.
